newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: U.S. passenger jet flies heroin into Colombia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. passenger jet flies heroin into Colombia.

text.p: A U.S. passenger jet was detained in Colombia for smuggling in heroin from the United States, authorities said on Friday.

Spokesmen for the National Police said the American Airlines jet was impounded late on Wednesday at the Alfonso Bonilla Aragon international airport in Cali after police found nearly seven ounces (197 grams) of heroin stashed beneath the arm rest of one of its passenger seats.
The crew and passengers had already left the plane when the heroin was discovered next to seat 29-A shortly after its arrival from Miami, the spokesmen said.

Colombia is a top supplier of heroin to the United States and police speculated that the drug may have been stashed aboard the plane during a previous flight from Cali to Miami by someone who decided not to risk carrying it through U.S. customs.
"Who'd want to bring heroin from the United States to Colombia?" one police officer asked in a telephone interview from Cali. "It's not like there's any shortage of the stuff down here."
American Airlines spokesmen in Bogota declined to comment on the case. The airline is a unit of AMR Corp.
